hypothesis: Train a task-agnostic bidirectional masked discrete-diffusion model over attachment-aware SAFE fragment sequences on the unlabeled corpus and freeze it for optimization. Within each objective session, maintain a dynamic vocabulary containing only fragments from oracle-evaluated molecules, attach fragments sampled with reward-rank bias to form a promising retained context, mask one complete fragment span, and regenerate that span through iterative parallel reverse denoising conditioned on the intact fragments. Feed accepted offspring back only by updating evaluated-fragment membership and reward statistics, allowing later contexts to exploit observed rewards while the denoiser can synthesize replacement fragments absent from the dynamic vocabulary.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic bidirectional masked discrete-diffusion model on SAFE fragment sequences from the allowed unlabeled corpus, then keep its weights frozen during every objective session. Initialize a dynamic fragment vocabulary only from oracle-evaluated molecules, score each fragment by the observed rewards of molecules containing it, and construct each new starting context by sampling and attaching high-scoring fragments. Replace one complete fragment span with mask tokens and iteratively denoise that span in parallel while conditioning on the retained fragments; canonicalize locally and submit only newly generated valid unique molecules. Oracle feedback updates fragment scores and admits fragments from evaluated offspring, so the generator can repeatedly refine promising chemistry while its learned conditional denoising can synthesize fragments outside the current vocabulary. Every candidate is therefore generated de novo rather than retrieved or ranked from the corpus, and reward-directed fragment regeneration targets improvement of the final Top-1 within the sparse feedback budget.

method_tags.proposal_mechanism: score-biased fragment attachment followed by whole-fragment masking and iterative bidirectional discrete-diffusion denoising

activation_observables.measurement: For every post-initial suggestion round with non-tied eligible fragment scores, record the mean normalized reward-rank percentile of fragments sampled into starting contexts minus its exact expectation under uniform sampling from the same compatible evaluated-fragment set, then aggregate the signed advantage across rounds.
activation_observables.name: selected_context_fragment_rank_advantage

activation_observables.measurement: For each emitted canonical molecule, record the evaluated source fragments, attachment operation, boundaries of the one completely masked fragment span, reverse-diffusion states, and decoded replacement; report the fraction traceable to a compatible attached context and at least two iterative bidirectional denoising steps that changed masked tokens, relative to a zero-trace baseline.
activation_observables.name: traceable_whole_span_diffusion_generation

activation_observables.measurement: Before each suggestion round, snapshot the dynamic evaluated-fragment vocabulary and report the fraction of emitted valid molecules whose denoised replacement contains at least one attachment-normalized fragment identity absent from that snapshot, together with the number of distinct new replacement fragments.
activation_observables.name: out_of_vocabulary_replacement_fragment_rate

activation_observables.measurement: For every suggestion round after the first observe message, report the fraction of starting contexts containing at least one fragment first admitted from a previously accepted adaptive offspring, and separately the fraction whose sampling weight changed because of an adaptive offspring's oracle score; compare both fractions between the first and second halves of the session.
activation_observables.name: adaptive_offspring_fragment_reuse

activation_observables.measurement: Hash all denoiser parameters immediately after loading and at session shutdown and report the maximum absolute parameter change; the hashes must match and numeric drift must be zero while fragment reward statistics continue to update.
activation_observables.name: frozen_denoiser_parameter_drift

activation_observables.measurement: For every suggestion round, report unique valid canonical molecules emitted per completed fragment-remasking attempt, with separate counts for incompatible attachment contexts, invalid SAFE decodes, sanitization failures, already proposed structures, and within-round collisions.
activation_observables.name: valid_novel_fragment_remask_yield

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus yields enough attachment-aware SAFE sequences for a compact masked denoiser to learn chemically productive conditional fragment completion within the frozen preparation budget.

The fixed initial molecules and accepted offspring can be decomposed into compatible attachment-labeled fragments, and their oracle scores provide enough variation for reward-rank-biased context sampling.

Useful objective improvements are reachable by retaining promising fragments while replacing one complete fragment span, including replacement chemistry not already present in the evaluated-fragment vocabulary.
Iterative SAFE-span denoising and local sanitization maintain sufficient valid, novel proposal yield to fill each evaluator-announced batch before the proposal-attempt limit.
Fragment-level reward attribution is informative enough that fragments from high-scoring evaluated molecules remain useful when attached in a new molecular context.

The result may not transfer when the objective depends primarily on nonlocal whole-molecule interactions, when useful structures require coordinated changes to several fragment spans, or when attachment-aware fragment decompositions systematically exclude the relevant chemistry.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if post-feedback emitted proposals cannot be traced to reward-biased fragments from oracle-evaluated molecules followed by whole-span iterative reverse denoising, if compatible non-tied fragment sets show no positive sampling-rank advantage, or if accepted adaptive offspring never change the fragment vocabulary or reward weights used by a later starting context.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to canonicalize and fragment the unlabeled corpus into attachment-aware SAFE sequences, train a compact masked categorical denoiser across randomly sampled diffusion noise levels, and publish its tokenizer, configuration, and frozen weights. Implement run mode to seed all randomness from init, load the denoiser on logical cuda:0 without updating its parameters, initialize task-local fragment reward statistics from the scored initial observations, build starting contexts from score-rank-biased evaluated fragments with compatible attachment labels, replace one whole fragment span by masks, iteratively unmask it with the model's ordinary conditional logits and no context-guidance extrapolation, decode and sanitize de novo molecules, and emit exactly the batch size announced by init after excluding invalid, previously proposed, and within-batch duplicate canonical structures. After each observe message, update fragment membership and scores solely from accepted oracle-evaluated offspring and retain generation provenance for subsequent rounds.
research_intent.mechanism: Train a task-agnostic bidirectional masked discrete-diffusion model over attachment-aware SAFE fragment sequences on the unlabeled corpus and freeze it for optimization. Within each objective session, maintain a dynamic vocabulary containing only fragments from oracle-evaluated molecules, attach fragments sampled with reward-rank bias to form a promising retained context, mask one complete fragment span, and regenerate that span through iterative parallel reverse denoising conditioned on the intact fragments. Feed accepted offspring back only by updating evaluated-fragment membership and reward statistics, allowing later contexts to exploit observed rewards while the denoiser can synthesize replacement fragments absent from the dynamic vocabulary.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, the optimizer must make sparse batchwise rewards alter later de novo proposals immediately while preserving enough fragment compatibility, molecular validity, and novelty to fill every batch; an offline generator alone has no objective signal, while restricting proposals to already observed fragments cannot synthesize missing local chemistry.

applicability_conditions: Supported on this allowed unlabeled corpus and preparation budget: preparation produced 100,000 usable attachment-aware training pairs, a 95-token SAFE vocabulary, 79 compatible attachment pairs, and a compact denoiser whose masked-token accuracy rose across all six epochs from 0.41027378424429367 to 0.5860402042344535.

Supported when the fixed initial molecules and feedback offspring admit attachment-aware decompositions with score variation: every task initialized 82 fragment records representing 75 identities, and every one of 145 rounds exposed non-tied eligible-score draws with positive reward-rank sampling advantage.

Supported when productive chemistry is reachable by retaining one evaluated context and replacing one fragment span: all 1,450 emissions had a complete compatible-attachment diffusion trace, and 1,079 replacements were outside their current dynamic-vocabulary snapshots.

Operationally supported under the 300-call, batch-10 protocol: every one of 145 batches filled before the local-attempt limit, despite 21 incompatible contexts, 31 sanitization failures, and 263 already-proposed structures; no invalid SAFE decode or within-round collision was emitted.

Supported when fragment-level feedback is reusable across contexts: adaptive offspring admitted 7,538 new task-local fragment records, and both adaptively introduced-fragment reuse and adaptive-score-weight reuse were nonzero in every later round and increased from the first to the second session half.

Evidence is limited to screening seed 0 and has no Parent or denoiser ablation, so it does not isolate the learned denoiser's score contribution or establish transfer when objectives require coordinated nonlocal changes across multiple spans, useful chemistry falls outside this SAFE model's support, or attachment decomposition excludes the decisive motif.

Lines 667-752 load the model on cuda:0, disable gradients, clone its parameters, seed session randomness, and initialize task-local fragments from the ten scored initial molecules; lines 770-813 admit accepted evaluated offspring and update fragment statistics; lines 831-919 enforce attachment compatibility and perform exponential reward-rank-weighted context and donor selection; lines 921-1041 execute six-step whole-span iterative reverse denoising; lines 1043-1210 snapshot the dynamic vocabulary, filter and emit unique valid molecules, retain complete provenance, and log all six observables; lines 1212-1229 audit the final model hash and numeric drift; and lines 1269-1305 close the suggest/observe feedback loop. Each seed-0 task log contains 29 fragment_diffusion_generation events, 290 molecule-level fragment_diffusion_offspring traces, 290 matching fragment_diffusion_offspring_observed events, and one frozen_denoiser_shutdown audit. observable_measurements.name: selected_context_fragment_rank_advantage
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this root. The pre-registered within-round uniform-sampling reference corresponds to signed rank advantage 0.0.
observable_measurements.value: Seed 0 across five tasks: all 145/145 suggestion rounds contained non-tied eligible fragment-score draws and had positive signed reward-rank advantage over the exact same-pool uniform expectation. The arithmetic mean of the 145 round-level advantages was 0.3462496743824561 (range 0.2579458703525964 to 0.4450070192823817); across 5,670 non-tied draws, the draw-weighted advantage was 0.3460216677293582. Task-level round means were deco_hop 0.33446961590302315, drd2_docking 0.3467366712761609, median_2 0.327097965242738, sitagliptin_mpo 0.35154473531139213, and zaleplon_mpo 0.37139938417896756, with 29/29 positive rounds on every task.

observable_measurements.name: traceable_whole_span_diffusion_generation
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this root; the pre-registered zero-trace baseline is 0.0.
observable_measurements.value: All 1,450/1,450 emitted canonical molecules (fraction 1.0), in all 145/145 rounds, recorded evaluated context and donor sources, attachment labels and the attached starting molecule, the boundaries of one completely masked fragment span, the decoded replacement, and six reverse-diffusion states. observable_measurements.name: out_of_vocabulary_replacement_fragment_rate
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this root, so no parent-node OOV replacement rate is available; a generator unable to synthesize outside the dynamic vocabulary has rate 0.0.
observable_measurements.value: Against each round's task-local pre-generation dynamic-vocabulary snapshot, 1,079/1,450 emitted molecules contained an attachment-normalized denoised replacement absent from that snapshot, an aggregate rate of 0.7441379310344828. observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this root. The directly observed pre-feedback generation-1 reference was 0.0 for both adaptive-fragment reuse and adaptive-score-weight reuse.
observable_measurements.value: Generation 1, before any adaptive feedback, had zero adaptive-fragment and adaptive-weight reuse on all five tasks. Iterative SAFE-span denoising and local sanitization maintain sufficient valid, novel proposal yield to fill each evaluator-announced batch before the proposal-attempt limit.
Fragment-level reward attribution is informative enough that fragments from high-scoring evaluated molecules remain useful when attached in a new molecular context.

The result may not transfer when the objective depends primarily on nonlocal whole-molecule interactions, when useful structures require coordinated changes to several fragment spans, or when attachment-aware fragment decompositions systematically exclude the relevant chemistry.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if post-feedback emitted proposals cannot be traced to reward-biased fragments from oracle-evaluated molecules followed by whole-span iterative reverse denoising, if compatible non-tied fragment sets show no positive sampling-rank advantage, or if accepted adaptive offspring never change the fragment vocabulary or reward weights used by a later starting context.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to canonicalize and fragment the unlabeled corpus into attachment-aware SAFE sequences, train a compact masked categorical denoiser across randomly sampled diffusion noise levels, and publish its tokenizer, configuration, and frozen weights. Implement run mode to seed all randomness from init, load the denoiser on logical cuda:0 without updating its parameters, initialize task-local fragment reward statistics from the scored initial observations, build starting contexts from score-rank-biased evaluated fragments with compatible attachment labels, replace one whole fragment span by masks, iteratively unmask it with the model's ordinary conditional logits and no context-guidance extrapolation, decode and sanitize de novo molecules, and emit exactly the batch size announced by init after excluding invalid, previously proposed, and within-batch duplicate canonical structures. After each observe message, update fragment membership and scores solely from accepted oracle-evaluated offspring and retain generation provenance for subsequent rounds.
research_intent.mechanism: Train a task-agnostic bidirectional masked discrete-diffusion model over attachment-aware SAFE fragment sequences on the unlabeled corpus and freeze it for optimization. Within each objective session, maintain a dynamic vocabulary containing only fragments from oracle-evaluated molecules, attach fragments sampled with reward-rank bias to form a promising retained context, mask one complete fragment span, and regenerate that span through iterative parallel reverse denoising conditioned on the intact fragments. Feed accepted offspring back only by updating evaluated-fragment membership and reward statistics, allowing later contexts to exploit observed rewards while the denoiser can synthesize replacement fragments absent from the dynamic vocabulary.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, the optimizer must make sparse batchwise rewards alter later de novo proposals immediately while preserving enough fragment compatibility, molecular validity, and novelty to fill every batch; an offline generator alone has no objective signal, while restricting proposals to already observed fragments cannot synthesize missing local chemistry.
